draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 53rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 34 at DE. He went 69th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Takkarist McKinley. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 sacks in 2020, 16th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 61 career games and 12 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (4 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 9 (82nd percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 18.9% (4th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 5.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, above the norm.
